thread:
Ava (Product): kicking off PRD intake for an "adaptive quality gate" for model rollouts. Problem stmt: several customers hit meaningful quality regressions after model swaps that were supposed to save cost. We need an automated guard so rollouts don't degrade key customer journeys. Asking for requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and rough implementation constraints.

Diego (Eng): +1. Can you clarify scope — is this only for hosted auto-rollouts or also Dedicated/Private?

Ava (Product): priority is hosted first, but design should be compatible with Dedicated (configurable). We need per-customer and per-route controls.

Sam (ML): For checks: recommend per-customer prompt set (up to 20 prompts) + automatic metric computation (BLEU / embed-sim / task-specific). What metrics do we want as signal?

Jordan (Customer Success): Customers most worried about hallucination and factuality on QA/ranking flows. CS has 3 customers asking for rollback-by-quality in last quarter.

Maya (Sales): Sales want a simple SLA play: if rollout causes X% drop on customer metric, auto-fallback and credit. We should flag which parts can be sellable.

Lena (Design): UX questions: where will engineers define prompt sets? Console? YAML in infra? Need wireframes for: create gate, run canary checks, override.

Ravi (Infra): infra constraints: we can't run heavy evals synchronously on rollout path. Need async eval with fast approx (embedding similarity) then fallback to offline full eval. Also watch GPU usage.

Ava (Product): Draft goals for PRD: 1) Prevent >5% degradation in customer-defined quality metric during auto-rollouts. 2) Provide clear reasons when gate blocks. 3) Low overhead (<200ms added to rollout path) and opt-in per-customer. Non-goals: not replacing full CI evals, not retrofitting older hard-coded rollouts.

Diego (Eng): Acceptance criteria (engineering): - rollout can be halted programmatically by gate API - gate returns pass/fail + diagnostics blob (top 3 failing prompts) - gate configurable per-customer with thresholds.

Sam (ML): Acceptance criteria (ML): - default metric: embedding cosine with baseline responses, threshold 0.92 for pass - optional task metrics for customers that provide labels - tests showing gate detects known regressions in our internal dataset.

Lena (Design): Acceptance criteria (UX): - Console: create gate flow with 3 steps (choose prompts, choose metric, threshold). - Alert UI that shows sample before/after + suggested rollback.

Ravi (Infra): Edge cases: - customer has <5 prompts: use shared benchmark set - model variant mismatch (tokenizer differences) -> fail open with warning - infra outage during eval -> conservative fail-close? we should fail-open for availability SLA customers and fail-close for safety-first tenants. Need per-tenant policy.

Jordan (Customer Success): For customers with compliance needs, prefer fail-close. We should add opt-in labels on accounts.

Maya (Sales): Can Sales get a one-pager of what we can promise for enterprise contracts? If we can promise auto-rollback + credits that's useful.

Ava (Product): Success metrics (proposed): - Reduce customer-reported rollout regressions by 80% in 6 months. - % of rollouts blocked by gate and subsequently rolled back < 1% (false positives target). - Time-to-diagnosis: median 10m from gate block to actionable insight in Console.

Diego (Eng): Quick implementation sketch: gate service receives candidate rollout batch, pulls prompt set, runs light-weight candidate inference (batch on CPU/GPU pool), computes embeddings via existing embedding endpoint, compares to baseline store, returns verdict. If fail -> abort rollout, write event to tracing, and trigger alert.

Sam (ML): We should store baseline responses at version pin to compare. Also consider using reranking overlay to detect distributional drift.

Lena (Design): Wireframe requests: I'll draft three small mocks. Need product to confirm fields: default prompt set size, metric options (embed-sim, BLEU, exact match), threshold slider.

Ravi (Infra): Ops checklist: rate limits on eval pool, circuit breaker if eval queue > X, telemetry hooks for cost accounting. Also per-customer reservation model for Dedicated.

Ava (Product): Edge cases to document in PRD: A) downstream services change responses (non-determinism) -> require multiple runs B) prompt sets stale -> auto-refresh policy C) merged rollouts across regions -> cross-region baseline mismatch.

QA-Bot: created checklist "adaptive-quality-gate" with items: "unit tests", "integration test with rollout service", "smoke on dedicated".

Jordan (Customer Success): I'll add 3 customer examples and the support tickets to the PRD draft for concrete acceptance tests.

Maya (Sales): please include an example contract clause for rollback credits. I can draft and attach.

Diego (Eng): Next steps: I'll spin up an RFC draft with proposed APIs and perf budget. Assigning owners: Diego (impl), Sam (metrics), Lena (UX), Ravi (infra), Jordan (customer cases). Ava will own PRD.

Ava (Product): thanks all. Can everyone drop short notes in the RFC doc by EOD Fri? Also paste any example prompts or customer tickets in the doc. We'll sync next Wed for scope negotiation. :thumbsup:
